description: A saved PostHog insight: a query (trends, funnel, retention, paths, SQL, ...) with a name, optionally shown on one or more dashboards. Computed results are never part of the resource.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the insight belongs to.

ShortId.description: The insight's short ID, as used in PostHog URLs (/insights/<ShortId>).

Name.description: Name of the insight. When unset, PostHog shows the derived name.

DerivedName.description: Fallback name generated from the query, shown when Name is unset.

Query.description: The insight's query as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString), usually an InsightVizNode wrapping a TrendsQuery, FunnelsQuery, RetentionQuery, etc., or a DataVisualizationNode wrapping a HogQLQuery. E.g. {"kind": "InsightVizNode", "source": {"kind": "TrendsQuery", "series": [{"kind": "EventsNode", "event": "$pageview"}]}}.

Dashboards.description: IDs of the dashboards (PostHog::ProductAnalytics::Dashboard) the insight is shown on. Removing an ID removes the insight's tile from that dashboard.
